note: No signingKeyId. The recipient signs AS the room, and which key does that is the entire authorization story — a request that omits it is asking the recipient to choose, which is the one decision it must never make on the caller's behalf.
No subject. Every credential here names who it is for; one without a subject confers on nobody, and a schema that allowed it would let a producer mint a credential it could not explain.
Bare/unnamespaced ext key — SPEC §4.5.1 requires every immediate child of ext to be reverse-DNS namespaced.

A role instead of a party. Membership is an explicit set of parties, never a role — a room that admitted a role would be a room whose membership its host could compute, and the host is the party the design keeps membership away from.
validUntil as a date rather than a date-time.
